Actual movement, another saved action, reload, old-run import and imported-run reload preserve exact encountered exports and matching content identity.

Quit updates the live page from its successful POST, hides Play, and terminates the server; the existing game still reloads offline with an unchanged saved run.
Fresh server restart reopens the live control page on the same origin after Quit.
